quests.name: Williden's Journal
quests.text: Return the journal to Williden Marshal somewhere in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Roll the Bones
quests.text: Bring 8 Dinosaur Bones to Spark Nilminer in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Shizzle's Flyer
quests.text: Collect 8 Webbed Diemetradon Scales and 8 Webbed Pterrordax Scales for Shizzle in Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
quests.text: Look around in the pond for a clue about who this wrecked raft may belong to.

quests.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
quests.text: Examine the items inside the pack and bring them to their owner.

quests.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
quests.text: Take Linken's Sword to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

quests.name: The Videre Elixir
quests.text: Seek out Gregan Brewspewer in northern Feralas. From him, learn how you may acquire the Videre Elixir, then return to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

quests.name: Meet at the Grave
quests.text: Go to the graveyard outside Gadgetzan, and use the Videre Elixir. Follow the rest of Donova's instructions to find Gaeriyan.

quests.name: A Grave Situation
quests.text: Resurrect, then look for the gravestone that Gaeriyan told you to find.

quests.name: Linken's Sword
quests.text: Deliver Linken's Superior Sword to Linken in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: A Gnome's Assistance
quests.text: Find J.D. Collie in the cave at Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: Muigin and Larion
quests.text: Collect 15 Bloodpetals and return to Muigin.

quests.name: A Visit to Gregan
quests.text: Take a Bloodpetal to Gregan Brewspewer in Feralas.

quests.name: Haze of Evil
quests.text: Collect 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze, then return to Muigin in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Larion and Muigin
quests.text: Hunt 5 Bloodpetal Lashers, 5 Bloodpetal Threshers, 5 Bloodpetal Flayers and 5 Bloodpetal Trappers for Larion at Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: Zapper Fuel
quests.text: Deliver the Unloaded Zapper and 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze to Larion in Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: Marvon's Workshop
quests.text: Travel to Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.

quests.name: Alien Ecology
quests.text: Use the Scraping Vial to collect a Hive Wall Sample from one of the Gorishi hive hatcheries in Un'Goro Crater. Look for the chambers with the hanging larval spawns.  Bring the Hive Wall Sample to Hol'anyee Marshal in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Bloodpetal Poison
quests.text: Collect 8 Bloodcap and 8 Gorishi Stings, and return to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: A Better Ingredient
quests.text: Retrieve a Putrid Vine from the guardian at the bottom of the Sunken Temple and return to Torwa Pathfinder.

quests.name: Crystals of Power
quests.text: Collect 7 Power Crystals of each color: red, blue, yellow, and green. Bring them to J.D. Collie at Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: The Northern Pylon
quests.text: Discover the location of the Northern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: The Eastern Pylon
quests.text: Discover the location of the Eastern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: The Western Pylon
quests.text: Discover the location of the Western Crystal Pylon.

quests.name: Making Sense of It
quests.text: Speak with J.D. Collie in a moment.

quests.name: Expedition Salvation
quests.text: Bring a Crate of Foodstuffs and Research Equipment to Williden Marshal in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Chasing A-Me 01
quests.text: Find A-Me 01 in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Chasing A-Me 01
quests.text: Find a Mithril Casing and return to A-Me 01 in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Chasing A-Me 01
quests.text: Escort A-Me 01 back to Karna Remtravel in Un'Goro Crater.

objectives.text: Protect A-Me 01 until you reach Karna Remtravel

quests.name: The Fare of Lar'korwi
quests.text: Find the carcass of Lar'korwi's freshest kill and steal a Piece of Threshadon Carcass before returning to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: The Scent of Lar'korwi
quests.text: Bring 2 Ravasaur Pheromone Glands to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Linken's Memory
quests.text: Find Eridan Bluewind in southern Felwood.

quests.name: Linken's Adventure
quests.text: Take the Silver Totem of Aquementas to Linken in Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: Aquementas
quests.text: Take the Book of Aquor, the Silvery Claws, and the Irontree Heart to Tanaris.  Use the Book of Aquor to summon Aquementas.  After you have the completed totem, take it to J.D. Collie in Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: Silver Heart
quests.text: Collect 11 Silvery Claws and 1 Irontree Heart for Eridan Bluewind in Felwood.

quests.name: The Apes of Un'Goro
quests.text: Bring 2 Un'Goro Gorilla Pelts, 2 Un'Goro Stomper Pelts, and 2 Un'Goro Thunderer Pelts to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Beware of Pterrordax
quests.text: Kill 10 Pterrordax and 15 Frenzied Pterrordax, then speak to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: Volcanic Activity
quests.text: Collect 9 samples of Un'Goro Ash from the fire elementals around the volcano in Un'Goro Crater, and return them to Liv Rizzlefix in Ratchet.

quests.name: The Mighty U'cha
quests.text: Bring U'cha's Pelt to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: A Little Help From My Friends
quests.text: Lead Ringo to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.  If Ringo faints, use Spraggle's Canteen to revive him.

objectives.text: Escort Ringo to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge

quests.name: Lost!
quests.text: Find Ringo at Fire Plume Ridge.

objectives.text: Escort Ringo to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge

quests.name: Uncanny Crystal
quests.text: Bring 1 Damaged Blue Crystal back to Torwa Pathfinder.

quests.name: Finding the Source
quests.text: Krakle in Un'Goro Crater wants you to find the hottest area of Fire Plume Ridge.  Whenever you find a hot spot, right click the thermometer to check the temperature. Keep looking until you find the hottest one.

quests.name: The New Springs
quests.text: Travel to Winterspring and speak with Donova Snowden.

quests.name: It's Dangerous to Go Alone
quests.text: Travel to Fire Plume Ridge, south of Marshal's Refuge.  Find Blazerunner and use the totem to remove his protective aura. Once he has been defeated, acquire the Golden Flame from the cave.

quests.name: The Bait for Lar'korwi
quests.text: Using the contents of Torwa's Pouch, summon Lar'korwi and defeat him. Then bring Lar'korwi's Head to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Digestible Research
quests.text: Collect 15 Partially Digested Journal Pages from the Shaper's Terrace.

quests.name: Panic at the Digsite
quests.text: Slay 6 Ravasaur Matriarchs, 9 Ironhide Ravasaurs and Venomridge in Shaper's Terrace.

quests.name: Mapping the Way Forward
quests.text: Find Interesting Landmarks in Shaper's Terrace and fill out the explorer's map at each.

quests.name: The Dark Crystal
quests.text: Gather a colorless Drained Crystal Fragment near the Achromatic Crystal in the Shaper's Terrace.

quests.name: Crystalline Elements
quests.text: Bring Mayena Earthseeker a Moist Crystal, a Charged Crystal, a Noxious Crystal and a Fiery Crystal from Shaper's Terrace.

quests.name: Essence of Seeping Slimes
quests.text: Gather 8 Seeping Slime Essence in the Shaper's Terrace.

quests.name: Ravasaur Provisions
quests.text: Collect 5 Diemetradon Meats and 5 Pterrodax Meats for Mor'vek in Un'Goro Crater.
